title: S, T, U
summary: Learn S, T, U, then practise with the keys you already know.
intro: Learn S, T, U, then practise with the keys you already know.

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your right hand and press s to type S. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: SSfS SS SSSf fSf Sf fSSS SfS fS SfSS

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your right hand and press t to type T. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: TjT TT jTT TjTj jTTj jj Tjj jTj TTj TjjT jTTT

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your left hand and press u to type U. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: UffU UUfU fUf UUU UU UUUU ff fU Uf

screens.text: Type each target carefully, then return to the home position before the next one.
screens.content: SUTS UU CTT TU SST TTS SS TST STTS TTU SCT USTT TTUU TT STT TS TTTT TSC

screens.text: Type each target carefully, then return to the home position before the next one.
